description:
Spacious one-bedroom terraced house located on a quiet side street in the sought-after Denton Holme area. The property features a cosy living room and a well-equipped dining kitchen on the ground floor, with a first-floor bathroom for added convenience.

A generous rear yard offers outdoor space for relaxation or entertaining. Situated in the popular "Urban Village" of Denton Holme, this home is within walking distance of a variety of amenities and recreational facilities, including river walks and playing fields.

The city centre is easily accessible, providing access to a wider range of amenities and services. The property is also within the catchment area of several highly regarded primary and secondary schools. Perfect for first-time buyers or those looking for a peaceful retreat in a convenient location.

Don't miss the chance to make this charming property your own.

Directions From the centre of Carlisle head towards Denton Holme. Once in Denton Holme take the 4th right turning up Trafalgar Street, turn right at the end and take the first right down Collingwood Street. Number 14 is on the left.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.

Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available.
